Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 1) Important renal/electrolyte adverse effects of diuretics include:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.option4: Hypovolaemia, hyponatraemia, hypokalaemia and metabolic alkalosis
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Diuretics can cause volume depletion and electrolyte imbalance. Hyponatraemia, hypokalaemia and metabolic alkalosis are important. Renal impairment and hypotension may also occur.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 2) Loop diuretics are associated with:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Loop diuretics increase urinary calcium loss. So they cause hypercalciuria. This contrasts with thiazides.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 3) Thiazide diuretics are associated with:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Thiazides decrease urinary calcium loss. They increase calcium reabsorption. So thiazides are associated with hypocalciuria.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 4) Metabolic adverse effects of diuretics include:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Diuretics may cause metabolic adverse effects. Glucose intolerance or hyperglycaemia can occur. Hyperlipidaemia is also listed.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 5) Thiazides may rarely be associated with:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Thiazides may cause miscellaneous adverse effects. These include hypersensitivity, erectile dysfunction and acute pancreatitis/cholecystitis. Electrolyte and metabolic effects are more commonly tested.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 6) The most dangerous acute adverse effect of opioids is:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Respiratory depression is the most dangerous acute opioid adverse effect. It can be life-threatening. Sedation and overdose increase the risk.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 7) Acute opioid use may cause:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.option2: Nausea, vomiting, pruritus, constipation and urinary retention
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Acute opioid adverse effects include nausea, vomiting and pruritus. Constipation and urinary retention may occur. Sedation, delirium and respiratory depression are also important.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 8) Chronic opioid use is associated with:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Chronic opioid use can cause tolerance and dependence. Withdrawal effects may occur when stopped. Abuse/addiction and impaired driving are also important.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 9) Which is a chronic opioid adverse effect?
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Chronic opioid use may cause hyperalgesia. It may also cause hypogonadism and immunosuppression. Tolerance and dependence are classic chronic effects.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 10) Urinary retention is mainly listed under:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Opioids can cause urinary retention during acute use. They also cause constipation, sedation and nausea. Respiratory depression is the most dangerous acute toxicity.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 11) A classic cardiac toxicity of digoxin is:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Digoxin toxicity can cause several arrhythmias. Atrial tachycardia with AV block is a classic combination. Bradycardia and ventricular arrhythmias may also occur.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 12) Xanthopsia in digoxin toxicity means:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Xanthopsia means yellow vision. It is an extra-cardiac manifestation of digoxin toxicity. Altered colour vision may also occur.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 13) Extra-cardiac digoxin toxicity commonly includes:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Digoxin toxicity commonly causes GI symptoms. Anorexia, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea are important. Visual symptoms such as xanthopsia may also occur.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 14) Which cardiac manifestation may occur in digoxin toxicity?
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Digoxin toxicity may cause ventricular ectopics and bigeminy. Ventricular tachycardia and fibrillation may also occur. Cardiac rhythm monitoring is important in suspected toxicity.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 15) The classic combination suggestive of digoxin toxicity is:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.option2: Atrial tachycardia with AV block plus xanthopsia
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Digoxin toxicity has cardiac and extra-cardiac features. Atrial tachycardia with AV block is classic. Xanthopsia means yellow vision and is a high-yield clue.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 16) Immunosuppressants requiring therapeutic drug monitoring include:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Ciclosporin and tacrolimus require TDM. They have narrow safety margins. Monitoring helps reduce toxicity and maintain efficacy.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 17) The cardiovascular drug requiring TDM is:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Digoxin requires therapeutic drug monitoring. It has narrow therapeutic index. Toxicity may involve arrhythmia, GI symptoms and visual disturbance.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 18) The respiratory drug requiring TDM is:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Theophylline has narrow therapeutic range. TDM helps avoid toxicity. Toxicity may involve GI symptoms, arrhythmias and seizures.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 19) CNS drugs requiring TDM include:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Lithium and phenytoin require monitoring. Both have narrow therapeutic ranges. Phenytoin also has nonlinear kinetics at higher levels.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 20) Antibacterials requiring TDM include:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Aminoglycosides require TDM in many situations. They can cause nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity. Renal function is especially important.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 21) The anticancer drug listed under TDM is:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Methotrexate is listed among drugs needing TDM. It has important toxicity risk. Monitoring helps reduce serious adverse effects.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 22) Methotrexate maintenance dose is usually:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Methotrexate is given weekly, not daily. Maintenance dose is 15–25 mg weekly orally or subcutaneously. Daily dosing error can be dangerous.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 23) Methotrexate monitoring includes:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Methotrexate can affect bone marrow and liver. FBC and LFT monitoring are needed. Toxicity risk increases with wrong dosing or comorbidity.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 24) Methotrexate indications include:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.option3: RA, PsA, JIA, axial SpA and CPPD
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Methotrexate is a classical DMARD. It is used in rheumatoid arthritis and psoriatic arthritis. It is also listed for JIA, axial SpA and CPPD.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 25) Sulfasalazine maintenance dose is:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Sulfasalazine is given orally. Maintenance dose is 2–4 g daily. It requires FBC and LFT monitoring.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 26) Sulfasalazine monitoring includes:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Sulfasalazine requires FBC and LFT monitoring. It can affect blood counts and liver function. Regular follow-up improves safety.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 27) Hydroxychloroquine requires monitoring of:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Hydroxychloroquine can cause retinal toxicity. Visual function monitoring is important. It is used in RA, SLE and CPPD.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 28) Hydroxychloroquine indications include:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Hydroxychloroquine is used in rheumatologic diseases. Indications include RA and SLE. CPPD is also listed.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 29) Hydroxychloroquine maintenance dose is:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Hydroxychloroquine is given orally. Maintenance dose is 200–400 mg daily. Visual monitoring is important.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 30) Leflunomide monitoring includes:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Leflunomide requires FBC, LFT and BP monitoring. It may affect liver function and blood pressure. Monitoring helps reduce harm during long-term treatment.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 31) Leflunomide maintenance dose is:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Leflunomide is given orally. Maintenance dose is 10–20 mg daily. It is used in RA and PsA.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 32) Leflunomide is indicated in:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Leflunomide is a classical DMARD. It is used in rheumatoid arthritis. It is also used in psoriatic arthritis.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 33) Azathioprine maintenance dose is:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Azathioprine is given orally. Maintenance dose is 1–2.5 mg/kg daily. It requires FBC and LFT monitoring.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 34) Azathioprine monitoring includes:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Azathioprine can affect blood counts and liver function. FBC and LFT monitoring are required. It is used in SLE and systemic vasculitis.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 35) Azathioprine indications include:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Azathioprine is used in autoimmune diseases. SLE and systemic vasculitis are listed indications. FBC and LFT monitoring are needed.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 36) Cyclophosphamide monitoring includes:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Cyclophosphamide can cause serious systemic toxicity. FBC, LFT and renal function are monitored. It is used in SLE and systemic vasculitis.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 37) Cyclophosphamide dose may be:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.option1: 2 mg/kg daily orally or 15 mg/kg IV
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Cyclophosphamide may be given orally or intravenously. Listed doses are 2 mg/kg daily orally or 15 mg/kg IV. Monitoring includes FBC, LFT and eGFR.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 38) Mycophenolate mofetil maintenance dose is:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Mycophenolate mofetil is given orally. Maintenance dose is 2–4 g daily. It is used in SLE and systemic vasculitis.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 39) Mycophenolate mofetil monitoring includes:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Mycophenolate mofetil requires FBC and LFT monitoring. It can affect blood counts and liver function. Regular monitoring improves safety.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 40) Ciclosporin A monitoring includes:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Ciclosporin can affect blood pressure and renal function. BP and eGFR monitoring are required. It is also a drug requiring TDM.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 41) Ciclosporin A maintenance dose is:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Ciclosporin A is given orally. Maintenance dose is 3–5 mg/kg daily. Monitoring includes BP and eGFR.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 42) Ciclosporin A indications include:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Ciclosporin A is used in RA and PsA. It requires BP and eGFR monitoring. It is also monitored by therapeutic drug levels.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 43) Therapeutic drug monitoring mainly aims to:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.option1: Convert oral drugs into IV drugs
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.option3: Maintain drug concentration within therapeutic range
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: TDM helps keep drug level effective but not toxic. It is useful for narrow therapeutic index drugs. It is especially valuable when response or toxicity is difficult to predict. Dose adjustment is guided by level plus clinical condition.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 44) A trough level is usually taken:
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Trough level is measured just before the next dose. It reflects the lowest concentration during the dosing interval. It is useful for avoiding accumulation and toxicity. Timing of sample is essential for correct interpretation.

Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.question: 45) Which set contains only drugs that commonly require TDM?
Diuretics , opioids, digoxin.exp: Digoxin, theophylline, lithium and phenytoin require TDM. They have narrow therapeutic ranges. Monitoring helps prevent toxicity while maintaining therapeutic effect.
